_comment: One entry per weapon: the rig that carries it, the node whose local Y runs along the striking part, and the contact segment (metres along that Y) the simulation sweeps. If the node carries extras.contact = { from, to } in the GLB it overrides `contact` here. The weapons lane adds an entry per weapon; scripts/bake-blades.mjs writes src/blade-paths.ts keyed by weapon.
